programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Toivon tuolla puolen
programme.desc: TOIVON TUOLLA PUOLEN kertoo hiililaivalla Helsinkiin rantautuvasta Khaledista (Sherwan Haji), Syyrian sodan pakolaisesta, joka etsii matkalla kadonnutta sisartaan.

programme.title: I Hired a Contract Killer
programme.desc: Henri Boulanger (Jean-Pierre Léaud) seisoo vähäpätöisen virkansa menetettyään keskellä Lontoon miljoonakaupunkia ja huomaa, ettei hänellä ole ainoatakaan ystävää eikä sukulaista.

programme.title: Bitchkram
programme.desc: Kristin laskee päiviä ylioppilaskirjoituksiin, jolloin hän voi jättää pikkukaupungin ja manipuloivan sisarensa unelmiensa New Yorkia varten. Kaikki sujuu täydellisesti, ja paikallislehti julkaisee hänen kolumnejaan.

programme.title: Arvottomat
programme.desc: Arvottomat on ajaton kuvaus siitä kuinka Pikkurikollinen Manne, maalaispoika Harri ja kaunis Veera ajavat Volgalla läpi suomalaismaisemien, poliisien ja gangsterien roikkuessa herkeämättä kintereillä.

programme.title: Hella W
programme.desc: Sankarittaren elämä. Hella Wuolijoen elämä ja työ. Runoilija, vakooja ja miljonääri, josta tuli kansainvälisesti tunnettu liikenainen, poliitikko ja näytelmäkirjailija, joka teki yhteistyötä Euroopan johtavien kirjailijoiden, kuten Bertolt Brechtin ja Maksim Gorkin.

programme.title: Cha Cha Cha
programme.desc: Siltojen alla asusteleva alkoholisti Matti (Matti Pellonpää) on saamassa Amerikan tädiltään huomattavan perinnön, mutta miehen tulisi olla edustuskelpoinen tädin vierailun ajan. Matti kertoo tilanteesta autokauppiaana työskentelevälle ystävälleen, joka ehdottaa korvausta vastaan roolien vaihtoa.

programme.title: Zombie ja kummitusjuna
programme.desc: Zombie on oman tiensä kulkija, joka ei pysty noudattamaan suomalaisen yhteiskunnan hänelle asettamia normeja. Zombie päättää jättää kaiken ja suunnata ulkomaille - paikkaan jossa kukaan ei odota häneltä mitään. Zombie ja kummitusjuna kuuluu monien mielestä Mika Kaurismäen elokuvien parhaimmistoon.

programme.title: Kaalbringenin Kurkunleikkaaja
programme.desc: Jossain piileksii murhaaja, jonka itseluottamus kasvaa hetki hetkeltä. Pieni eurooppalainen rannikkokaupunki, Kaalbringen, on kauhun vallassa. Kuten myös Maardam. Lyhyen ajan sisällä kaupunkeja on järkyttänyt kaksi raakaa murhaa. Missä ja milloin ”kurkunleikkaaja” iskee seuraavaksi?

programme.title: Gourmet Club
programme.desc: Paavo Ylönen kuuluu yläluokkaiseen Gourmet Clubiin, johon jokainen jäsen tuo vuorollaan eksoottisen raaka-aineen. Se, joka tunnistaa mikä kätkeytyy gourmet-annokseen, voittaa suuren summan rahaa.

programme.title: John Hron
programme.desc: Länsi-Ruotsi, kesä 1995. Neo-natiivien väkivaltaisuudet horjuvat koko maassa. Elokuva on todellinen tarina 14-vuotiaasta kavereista Kungälvin pienestä yhteisökoodista.

programme.title: Ykköset Ja Nollat - Osa 2
programme.desc: Kriitikoiden ylistämä brutaali gangsteridraama Johan Renckiltä! FBI ja Interpol saavat vihiä suuresta luottokorttisotkusta, ja narkkari Sebbe napataan kiinni epäiltynä. Poliisin aloittaessa kuulustelun he saavat kuulla uskomattoman tarinan Göteborgin alamaailmasta.

programme.title: In the Name of God
programme.desc: Elokuva Jumalanpalvelus kertoo Theodorista, joka on pappi pienessä kylässä, josta tulee puheenaihe siitä syystä, että hänen vaimonsa parani kuin ihmeen kautta tappavasta taudista Theodorin rukousten ansiosta.

programme.title: Garden Lane
programme.desc: Kun Eric ja Elin tapaavat jälleen aikuisina hautajaisissa, he kokevat uudelleen synkän maagisen kesän, jolloin he tapasivat ensimmäisen kerran. He olivat pelkkiä lapsia, mutta heidän vanhempansa Linda ja Peter olivat ongelmakäyttäjiä.

programme.title: Bieffekterna
programme.desc: Lääketieteen opiskelijat ja ohjelmoijat Julia ja Rebecca kuuluvat Lundin yliopiston eliittiryhmään, joka tutkii kiistanalaista tieteellistä menetelmää biohakkerointia, geenitekniikan uutta toivoa, joka saattaa merkitä tappavien sairauksien loppua.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Horizon Line
programme.desc: Ex-pariskunta tapaa vuosien jälkeen osallistuessaan hyvän ystävänsä häihin. Heidän lentäessään trooppiselle saarelle valtameren yli pienellä, yksimoottorisella lentokoneella, pilotti saa kohtalokkaan sydänkohtauksen.

programme.title: Hella W
programme.desc: Sankarittaren elämä. Hella Wuolijoen elämä ja työ. Runoilija, vakooja ja miljonääri, josta tuli kansainvälisesti tunnettu liikenainen, poliitikko ja näytelmäkirjailija, joka teki yhteistyötä Euroopan johtavien kirjailijoiden, kuten Bertolt Brechtin ja Maksim Gorkin.

programme.title: John Hron
programme.desc: Länsi-Ruotsi, kesä 1995. Neo-natiivien väkivaltaisuudet horjuvat koko maassa. Elokuva on todellinen tarina 14-vuotiaasta kavereista Kungälvin pienestä yhteisökoodista.

programme.title: Juha
programme.desc: Juha (Sakari Kuosmanen, Kauas pilvet karkaavat) ja Marja (Kati Outinen, Sauna) elävät yhdessä onnellisina ja viattomina kuin lapset kunnes käärme luikertelee paratiisiin Shemeikan (André Wilms, Boheemielämää) hahmossa. Juha perustuu Juhani Ahon kuuluisaan romaaniin.

programme.title: Gourmet Club
programme.desc: Paavo Ylönen kuuluu yläluokkaiseen Gourmet Clubiin, johon jokainen jäsen tuo vuorollaan eksoottisen raaka-aineen. Se, joka tunnistaa mikä kätkeytyy gourmet-annokseen, voittaa suuren summan rahaa.

programme.title: JP ja Murtovaras
programme.desc: Sallikkalan kuntaa piinaa sarja murtovarkauksia, ja luvattomalle yöseikkailulle lähtenyt lapsikolmikko luulee nähneensä varkaan itse teossa! Nyt on perustettava salapoliisitoimisto ja ratkaistava juttu!

programme.title: Valehtelija
programme.desc: Valehtelija on kuvaus nuoresta huulenheittäjästä, joka ei koskaan puhu totta. Aki Kaurismäen esittämä nuori mies kuljeskelee pitkin Helsingin katuja ja koittaa lainata rahaa tutuilta ja tuntemattomilta, milloin milläkin verukkeella.

programme.title: Van Veeteren - Carambole
programme.desc: Mies törmää autollaan 14-vuotiaaseen poikaan, joka saa surmansa välittömästi. Tapahtuma-aikana on pimeää ja sateista, ja mies pakenee onnettomuuspaikalta. Tämä on virhe, jota hän tulee katumaan katkerasti, ja joka muuttaa hänen koko elämänsä.

programme.title: Cha Cha Cha
programme.desc: Siltojen alla asusteleva alkoholisti Matti (Matti Pellonpää) on saamassa Amerikan tädiltään huomattavan perinnön, mutta miehen tulisi olla edustuskelpoinen tädin vierailun ajan. Matti kertoo tilanteesta autokauppiaana työskentelevälle ystävälleen, joka ehdottaa korvausta vastaan roolien vaihtoa.

programme.title: Ariel
programme.desc: Ariel kertoo Taistosta (Turo Pajala, Hamlet liikemaailmassa), pohjoissuomalaisesta kaivosmiehestä. Kun kaivos suljetaan, Taisto kääntää Cadillacin keulan kohti etelää. Helsingissä Taisto asuu Pelastusarmeijan yömajassa, etsii työtä ja rakastuu uutteraan yksinhuoltajaäitiin.

programme.title: Pidä huivista kiinni, Tatjana
programme.desc: Koskenkorvaa litkivä automekaanikko Reino (Matti Pellonpää) ja kahvista riippuvainen peräkamarin poika Valto (Mato Valtonen) lähtevät viettämään viikonloppua ja kohtaavat matkalla virolaisen Tatjanan (Kati Outinen) ja venäläisen Klavdian (Kirsi Tykkyläinen).

programme.title: Viking Blood
programme.desc: Ryöstöretkellä ollessaan Tor-viikinki joutuu yllättäen keskelle vuosituhannen sotaa, jota käyvät vanhat ja uudet aasajumalat. Tor päättää, ettei yksikään heistä ansaitse voittoa ja valtaherruutta.

programme.title: Historiaa Tehdään Öisin
programme.desc: Harry on CIA-agentti, joka toimii peitetehtävissä helsinkiläisen Moving Planet -jazzklubin omistajana. Nuori SVR-agentti Natasha asuu myös Helsingissä – hänen tehtävänä on vakoilla Harrya.

programme.title: Calamari Union
programme.desc: Calamari Union on kaikkien aikojen kulttiklassikko, joka kertoo seitsemäntoista Frankin ja yhden Pekan matkasta Kallion varjoisilta kujilta kohti Eiran raikkaita tuulia, joista he ovat kuulleet isovanhempiensa kertovan.

programme.title: Jimmy Jones
programme.desc: Hyväsydäminen pikkurikollinen Jimmy Jones Malmöstä yrittää tienata rutkasti rahaa. Hän toimii välikätenä huumekaupassa, jota käyvät hollantilainen huumesyndikaatti ja Tukholmassa oleskeleva serbialainen pokerinpelaaja Dragan.

programme.title: Ykköset Ja Nollat - Osa 2
programme.desc: Kriitikoiden ylistämä brutaali gangsteridraama Johan Renckiltä! FBI ja Interpol saavat vihiä suuresta luottokorttisotkusta, ja narkkari Sebbe napataan kiinni epäiltynä. Poliisin aloittaessa kuulustelun he saavat kuulla uskomattoman tarinan Göteborgin alamaailmasta.

programme.title: Münsterin juttu
programme.desc: Varakas viininmaahantuoja löydetään brutaalisti murhattuna voimakkaan iskun jälkeen päähän. Münster saa tapauksen tutkittavakseen.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen: Phyllis Logan, Claire Thompson, Freddy Bird, and Ollie Smith

programme.title: Matter Of Respect
programme.desc: Heartbroken, Kubra pulls away. Emir intensifies his search for evidence, and Kubra vows never to return to Yigit.

programme.title: Dancin' Angels
programme.desc: A dance marathon with $5,000 in prize money attracts Joe and Sally Fairgate to compete, but when Sally disappears, Joe enlists the Angels' help in finding her. They investigate and question suspects, promoter P.J. Wilkes, investor Al Norman and leading dance couple, Steve and Jenny. Bosley discovers that Norman is a small time racketeer and Steve is a convicted hood from New York. The Angels approach the suspects to find motives for Sally's murder, making Wilkes and Norman very nervous. But when dance band singer, Billy, is found dead after an altercation with band leader Elton Mills, Kelly mistakenly confronts Mills, who confines her until he can kill her later. Wilkes and Norman admit moving Sally's body after Mills killed her. The Angels busy themselves searching for Kelly. She escapes from Mills and following a brief shootout, he is captured by the Angels, ending his attempt at a comeback as a dance band leader.

programme.title: Harrigan's Angel
programme.desc: When Starrett Electronics is the victim of a second large heist, Paul Starrett's insurance company insists he have additional help for Joseph Harrigan, a bumbling, disheveled private investigator covering the case. The Angels investigation develops leads and they question photo engraver Belkin materials and shipper Felber, who both have police records linked to Starrett. Kris and Harrigan figured out the heist method but Starrett has already ordered them killed. The Angels confront and arrest Starrett for robbing his own business. They then rush to Harrigan's apartment in time to capture Felber and Belkin attempting to kill Harrigan.

programme.title: An Angel's Trail
programme.desc: Jill Munroe is taken hostage when she accidentally stumbles into a gas station robbery. Convict Sam Mason and his sons, Clint and Harley, escape into the desolate desert hills keeping Jill tied in the back of their getaway van. Tiffany researches the geography of the highlands and discovers an old road overlooked by the search party. Hampered by wind and rain, Kris continues to lead the search for her sister when they find indications that the convicts are nearby. Jill befriends the retarded Harley who retaliates against his cruel father by battering Sam unconscious -- saving Jill from certain death. Jill sees that Harley receives special attention in the best institution for the mentally handicapped.

programme.title: Nips And Tucks
programme.desc: When a Congressional witness is found dead, the Angels investigate plastic surgeon Paul Redmont's association with racketeer Vern Maddox, who they learn wants plastic surgery to change his identity. Kris and Bosley pose as a couple seeking cosmetic surgery for Bosley, while Tiffany gathers information posing as a nurse. Redmont's girlfriend and former revolutionary, Barbara Brown, arranges for Maddox's surgery. But when nurse Elena discovers Maddox's true identity as the million dollar swindler of government pension funds, Barbara kills her. Barbara then forces Tiffany to replace Elena during the surgery of Maddox and she blackmails Redmont into completing the operation. The other Angels burst into the operating room where they subdue and apprehend Barbara and Maddox and inform Redmont that his very professional work almost changed their suspect's identity.

programme.title: Angel's Child
programme.desc: While working on a robbery case, Kelly calls for police assistance when she observes the thieves escaping. A shootout occurs and one of the thieves, Joe Willow, escapes after killing a cop. Sgt. Cates takes his anger and frustration home where he batters his son, Greg. When Kelly realizes that Cates beats his son, she confronts the Sgt. and presses for child abuse charges. Joe Willow's underworld friends, Stone and Burke, observe the welfare court case awarding Kelly temporary custody of Greg while Cates works on the murder case. The thugs kidnap Kelly and Greg and attempt to persuade Cates to drop the search for Willow. Kelly manipulates her telephone answering service to alert the Angels and Cates to her house where she is being held captive. In the ensuing shootout, Kelly and Greg escape and the Angels apprehend the thugs and Willow. Cates admits his problem and is reunited with his son.

programme.title: Three For The Money
programme.desc: When three unsuspecting investors are bilked by racketeer, Harley Dexter, the Angels scheme to con Dexter into returning the money. Kelly persuades Dexter to use laundered syndicate money to buy her truckload of Mayan artifacts; Kris works an ingenious switch of her worthless Rolls Royce for Dexter's Rolls and Tiffany poses as a Senator's aide demanding payment to stop the Senator's investigation of Dexter's syndicate ties. Dexter is ruined when the syndicate realizes that the Maya artifacts are phony. Kris Rolls Royce is junked and the Senator arranges a Grand Jury injunction against Dexter. The original investors receive their money and Dexter is last seen being cornered by his syndicate ties demanding their money.

programme.title: Toni's Boys
programme.desc: After a number of attempts on the Angels' lives, Charlie hires Antonia Blake to protect them. Toni's boys (Bob, Matt and Cotton) are expert detectives but the Angels resist their orders to stay undercover and not venture out of Toni's mansion. Racketeer Danny Flores is tipped off to the presence of an investigation in which Tiffany figures prominently. They are sleuthing his modeling agency so he captures her in hopes of drawing the other Angels around. The guys uncover Flores' winery, a front for a scheme to infiltrate an elite gathering but Flores recognizes Kris and Kelly as hostesses at this affair for the rich, and in an effort to save them, Toni's boys are forced to blow their cover. Flores' men overcome the guys and then proceed with their original plan to seal the Angels behind a brick wall where they will suffocate. Toni's boys storm the hacienda and wine cellar.

programme.title: One Love… Two Angels, Part 1
programme.desc: Part 1 -Kelly is thought to be the orphaned daughter of wealthy hotel owner, Oliver Barrows, whose search for his Margaret ends when the resemblance between Kelly and a huge oil portrait of Barrows' deceased wife is indistinguishable. Kelly is suddenly heir to the massive Barrows fortune, including the stately Barrows Hotel, which was scheduled to be donated to the city if no heir were found.

programme.title: One Love… Two Angels, Part 2
programme.desc: Part 2 -Kelly is thought to be the orphaned daughter of wealthy hotel owner, Oliver Barrows, whose search for his Margaret ends when the resemblance between Kelly and a huge oil portrait of Barrows' deceased wife is indistinguishable. Kelly is suddenly heir to the massive Barrows fortune, including the stately Barrows Hotel, which was scheduled to be donated to the city if no heir were found.

programme.title: Angel in Hiding, Part 1
programme.desc: Part 1 - Kelly and Kris pose as models and secure jobs with the Woodman Agency after the disappearance and subsequent death of model Jody Mills. They are joined by Julie Rogers, who, they later find out, is an undercover police officer working with partner Harry.

programme.title: Angel in Hiding, Part 2
programme.desc: Part 2 - Kelly and Kris pose as models and secure jobs with the Woodman Agency after the disappearance and subsequent death of model Jody Mills. They are joined by Julie Rogers, who, they later find out, is an undercover police officer working with partner Harry.

programme.title: To See An Angel Die
programme.desc: After the Angels check into their hotel in Hawaii, Kris is kidnapped by a man who holds her responsible for his wife's suicide.

programme.title: Angels Of The Deep
programme.desc: Kris joins mysterious Bianca Blake in diving to look for wrecked ships. They find The Starshine, a ship that sunk with a load of marijuana aboard -- but fail to notice that they are being observed by Claude and Walrus.

programme.title: Island Angels
programme.desc: In Hawaii, the Angels and Bosley get word that a professional assassin has been hired to kill Eric Nilsson of an international peace-keeping organization. Nilsson is scheduled to speak at the Convention Center in 48 hours.

programme.title: Waikiki Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are in Honolulu (hoping for two weeks of sun, surf and no assignments) when they receive a call from Charlie advising that Congressman Knight's son, David, honeymooning with his wife, Marti, has been attacked while moonlight picnicking on the beach.

programme.title: Hula Angels
programme.desc: Steve Moss, owner of the Tropicana nightclub in Honolulu, is kidnapped, after firing young dancer, Donna Lindsey. He is taken in a van to a warehouse, where he is put into a cage with 60's rock music blaring in his ears.

programme.title: Moonshinin' Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are sent to Moonshine country in the Deep South to investigate problems between long-feuding bootlegging families, the Bartletts and the Catlins. Son, Bobby Dan Bartlett, who is injured trying to get a shipment of whiskey to market and Catlin daughter, Melinda, are in love, much to the displeasure of both families.

programme.title: He Married An Angel
programme.desc: The Angels are hired by Barbara Stone and her sister, Jane, to track down John Thornwood. He has swindled them out of $100,000 by promising to marry Jane and persuading her to invest money in a phony South American oil exploration venture.

programme.title: Taxi Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are called in to investigate, when Tom Archer, who owns a cab company with his wife Laurie, is badly burned as his cab explodes. Laurie Archer reveals that they have been getting threatening phone calls and someone obviously is trying to put them out of business.

programme.title: Angel On The Line
programme.desc: Mary and her very attractive friend, Lois, go to the Hot Line Club, a singles club with a phone at each table. The phone rings and the caller asks to speak to Lois. He then tells her that she is so pretty he has to kill her.

programme.title: Chorus Line Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are hired by Ruth Traina, who has invested $150,000 in a Darian Mason Production, to investigate the disappearance of two of the best dancers. Kelly auditions a job as a dancer; Julie is her agent/manager and Kris poses as a writer/critic doing a story on Mason.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The spectacular Fefor Arena hosted for the 8th time the Worlds Strongest Viking, part of the SCL World Series. But with the absence of former title holders its anyones game. Again, a very spectacular episode of the Strongman Champions League here in Norway.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, the Titan, former double World champion from Latvia will compete against his fellow countryman and the current World champion - Aivars Smaukstelis. With 8 events over 2 stages the contestants are pushed to their limits in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Dainis Zageris and Aivars Smaukstelis, both from Latvia have a serious, strong battle in the this second and final episode of the SCL Finland 2020. Watch the unbelievable and brute power of these athletes in the last 4 events to crown the winner.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL Germany event takes place in an ancient castle called Die Burg in the heart of Germany. Its here where 5 world record attempts take place across 5 different events with 10 athletes. They will go to the max! See this and much more in the SCL Germany 2020.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Norway is normally all about snow, wind, and cold weather. Our brave athletes are used to compete under conditions few other athletes have competed in, but after COVID delays the competition has been moved from winter to summer bringing in a whole new range of challenges. With an impressive athlete list who will be the winner across 5 cruel events?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Were in sunny Finland for the next stage of a double-bill of SCL action, but this time its a team event. A truly fantastic event with 6000 spectators. Even during COVID times this was exceptional! 8 Strong Teams where fighting for the title over a crazy 9 events.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland, done over 9 cruel events. In this episode the last and final 5 events take place. 8 Strong Teams are fighting for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next set of challenges are set in sunny Esposende in Portugal. With stars such as Travis Ortmayer, Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland, and Ervin Toots from Estonia. While Fabio Silva will defend the honour in his own country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back in Germany, with the world record breakers. We promise you this is going to be amazing. Do not move from that seat, because we are going to see some records smashed today. Over 6 cruel events, you will see who gets crowned of the King Of The Castle!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With the next episode of Strongman Champions League Germany. Its the world record breakers, and in the last show we set two new records. Can more be records be broken before the king of the castle is crowned?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Kokkola in Finland. This city will be the setting for the Lightweight World championship. Out of 24 athletes, only 16 will make it through to the final day, but who will champion each event and who is going to be eliminated?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Its the second day, and the top 16 athletes have made it through to the final round. With another 4 events to go who will get the crown of world champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Ukraine and the wonderful capital city of Kyiv. Were here for the second time for the iconic truck pull World Championships! The reigning World champion Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland will defend his title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, a final chance for our athletes to get vital world series ranking points on board to give them the best possible chance of success and an initial advantage at the finals. It's the last show before the world finals and the top 10 places are up for grabs, but who will they be?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Farnborough, England, for the 2025 World Championship Truck Pull at the British Motor Show. Top international athletes compete in this spectacular test of strength, pulling massive vehicles as crowds gather for a thrilling showcase of power and endurance.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn’t been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland the home of Legends Mariusz Pudzianowkski and Krzystof Radzikowski. Who will grab the title here in holiday resort Sopot, on the great Balrtic Sea with 6 events and 12 athlets in the mix!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: it’s been a long time since the world series held a championship here in Sarajevo. Let’s see what test of strength this destination holds for our athletes. And what fantastic athletes are here again in Stage 12 of the SCL World Series. The strongman champions league Bosnia is another iconic Strongman event with the return of Rongo Keen from Australia and Portugal winner 2022 George Sulaiman.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Sibiu in Romania. It’s an important day for some of these athletes, because four of them have a real chance of getting into our all-exclusive world finals. There’s only one more stage after this to get those all-important extra points. So, there’s going to be some fireworks, who will take the title here and who will qualify for the World Finals?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This is it the last show before the world final. These guys have really got to fight for the points now, this is going to be action packed, whilst these guys fight it out all day.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkey’s south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season of Strongman Champions League. Here in the sunshine, we’ll finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is. You could not ask for a better setting. After months of hard-work, if not years for some of these lads, we find out who will take the world title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome, to day two of the strongman champions league 2022 finals here in Alanya, Turkey. It’s all up for grabs now, everyone is fighting for the world title belt. This is an epic episode where we finally crown the World champion of 2022.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the 2023 Strongman Champions League in Vaasa, Finland! This year’s event introduces a knockout format with 6 intense events over 90 minutes, ending in a unique deadlift face-off with boats.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage 2 of the Strongman Champions League 2023 is set in Zrenjanin, Serbia. This exciting event features 5 challenging contests, including a superhuman Yoke race. As the SCL World Series Tour continues, athletes will battle it out to claim the yellow leader’s position for the season. Don’t miss this incredible stage of strength and endurance!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The World’s Strongest Team will be crowned in this edition of SCL, here in Kalajoki-Finland we’ve picked some of the best in the business, teamed them up, and they’ll be going all out against each other. It’s now no longer about being a lonely wolf, but more about the pack mentality. It is a competition over 7 events, including a Big 2-man Log lift and heavy deadlift. Let’s start the action.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League in Holland at the Dru Factory in ULFT. A great location for a spectacular battle with 14 Athletes over 3 events! The first 3 events in this episode are Truckpull/ Superyoke and Farmerswalk, with 2 massive logs of 150 kg in their hands. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it’s the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, strongman fans across the world, we are back for SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it’s about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland, continues with the last 3 events, here at the Dru Factory in ULFT. The events in this episode are the Viking Press, Wheel Flip and the Atlas Stones, with 180 kg in the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time ever, the World’s Strongest Latino competition has begun. This two-day event in Porto, Portugal, features 20 athletes from around the world competing in 8 events. After 4 grueling events, the top 12 will advance to the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League World Record Breakers 2023 starts with a 25-ton snow plow! Crazy machines are pulled and pushed, with many kilograms moved. A few new world records are set in this competition.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We have returned to the powerhouse of Portugal for an edge-of-your-seat galactic battle. If all the planets collided at once, it wouldn’t compare to the bang of this show. Get ready for the battle of the beasts; it’s the heaviest show in the universe, the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL UK has landed in Gloucester it is workout war fitness for the ferocious, it’s going to be a a battle of the brutal, a rampage of the roofless. This is going to be a massacre of the muscles. You know it by now, but just in case you don’t, this is strongman champions league.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On the menu this week it’s medieval madness, we’ve come back to the middle ages to test our noble men through a muscle gaining of events. They are hoping and we are hoping that one will survive to take the title of the world’s strongest Viking. The official World's Strongest Viking is this time in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This week is a good one, can you feel the energy? Sit still, just look at me and try and feel the energy, because I can tell you, the atmosphere here is electric, it’s explosive, there is a pure elemental force going through these athletes' veins. I’m shaking because it’s Poland, it’s powerful, it’s strongman champions league, and you know what I'm going to say, get ready because it’s about to get heavy.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Stage 10 of the Strongman Champions League 2025 arrives in Gdańsk, Poland, where a world-class lineup competes in tough events including deadlift, log lift, and loading race. With top athletes like Aivars Smaukstelis and Adam Roszkowski in action, the battle intensifies as the season nears its climax.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Poland part 2 - Who will win the title in Poland and take 25 points for the world ranking. It is very exciting on the top, in part 1 between Poland and Latvia. Another great episode with super strongman events such as: Bag Toss Medley, Log Lift Reps and the Powerstairs. Also an interview with Mateusz Kieloszkowski, the all time favorite champion from Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: It’s time to show our strength and gain respect from the gods of Olympus. Our gladiators have many events set out by no other than Hercules himself. The coliseum is ready here on this mythological island of Cyprus, so we have landed in Limassol were again 12 Top Strongmen are battling for the title and ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The only and official world championship Truckpulling for its 10th year, again at the Strongman Champions league. With the 3 times Worldchampion Kelvin de Ruiter – defending his title. This championship has trucks in all shapes and sizes which is a lot like our athletes, there all different pay loads, but does the biggest win or is it the strongest.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Years and years of determination has brought us here today, when all the walls felt like they were caving in perseverance. When their bodies were screaming, hurting, shouting stop, beneath. These are the things which make up a man, these are the things that bring you world finalists. This episode they fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Part 2 of the World Finals of the Strongman Champions League tour 2023 at the Sarajevo Centar Skenderija in Bosnia. 3 Events was done already and amazing results have been set. programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 10 years there is another edition of THE ICEMAN in minus 25 degrees and snow, and it is also the first stage in the MLO Strongman Champions League. programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.desc: Simon Westin (The Expendables 2) ohjaama ja Nicholas Cagen tähdittämä räjäyttävä toimintatrilleri.

programme.title: Turpiin vaan ja tuplaten

programme.title: Legal Action
programme.desc: Lahjakas asianajaja Casey McKay matkustaa ex-vaimonsa kotikaupunkiin puolustamaan tämän veljeä, jota syytetään piirisyyttäjän murhasta. Siellä McKay saa selville salaliiton, joka johtaa hänet avoimeen konfliktiin kaupungin korruptoituneimman rakennuttajan Gatesin kanssa.

programme.title: Pete Smalls Is Dead
programme.desc: Hollywoodin taakseen jättänyt käsikirjoittaja joutuu palaamaan unelmien kaupunkiin ohjaajaystävänsä kuoltua.

programme.title: Delta Farce
programme.desc: Kolmea ystävystä luullaan sotilaiksi ja heidät laitetaan Irakin lentokoneeseen. Kun heidät on tiputettu lentokoneesta, löytävät he itsensä syrjäisestä kylästä, joka tarvitsee kipeästi apua. Pystyvätkö he olemaan sankareita oikeasti?

programme.title: TMNT
programme.desc: Splinter; rotta sensei; aistii, että hänen neljä teini-ikäistä kilpikonnaopettajaansa ovat eronneet ja heidän on luotava side voittaakseen muinaisen hirviön.

programme.title: Alvin Ja Pikkuoravat 3
programme.desc: Lomailevat pikkuoravat ja tyttötrio muuttavat luksusristeilijän omaksi leikkikentäkseen kunnes he haaksirikkoutuvat syrjäiselle saarelle.

programme.title: Ghost Rider - Koston Henki
programme.desc: Johnny Blaze taistelee edelleen kiroustaan vastaan paholaisen palkkionmetsästäjänä. Kun salainen uskonnollinen lahko palkkaa hänet tehtävään, hän ei tunne olevansa valmis käyttämään Ghost Riderin voimiaan ja valtaansa jälleen kerran.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Keskiajan historia kirjoitetaan uudelleen, kun Jamal Walker putoaa Medieval World -teemapuiston vallihautaan ja huomaa siirtyneensä ajassa taaksepäin.

programme.title: Varkaita ja veijareita
programme.desc: Bud Spencer esittää kovanyrkkistä poliisia, ylikonstaapeli Parkeria, joka saa tehtäväkseen ottaa kiinni lipevän gigolon, Tony Roman. Tony todistaa Mafian tappoiskun.

programme.title: Horizon Line
programme.desc: Ex-pariskunta tapaa vuosien jälkeen osallistuessaan hyvän ystävänsä häihin. Heidän lentäessään trooppiselle saarelle valtameren yli pienellä, yksimoottorisella lentokoneella, pilotti saa kohtalokkaan sydänkohtauksen.

programme.title: Instrument of War
programme.desc: Kun Yhdysvaltain ilmavoimien B-24 pommikoneen pilotti Clair Cline ammutaan alas ja vangitaan Saksassa, hänen osaltaan yksi sota loppuu ja toinen - toivon ylläpitäminen - alkaa.

programme.title: Stolen
programme.desc: Simon Westin (The Expendables 2) ohjaama ja Nicholas Cagen tähdittämä räjäyttävä toimintatrilleri.

programme.title: Awake
programme.desc: Mies herää sairaalassa, eikä hänellä ole muistikuvaa siitä, kuka hän on. Pian selviää, että häntä etsitään murhasarjasta epäiltynä.

programme.title: Surrounded
programme.desc: Entinen sotilas Mo Washington matkaa länteen etsimään kultakaivosta. Väijytys pakottaa hänet vangitsemaan lainsuojattoman, johtaen taisteluun karussa erämaassa. Ohjaaja: Anthony Mandler. Pääosissa Letitia Wright, Jamie Bell ja Michael K. Williams.

programme.title: Jimmy Jones
programme.desc: Hyväsydäminen pikkurikollinen Jimmy Jones Malmöstä yrittää tienata rutkasti rahaa. Hän toimii välikätenä huumekaupassa, jota käyvät hollantilainen huumesyndikaatti ja Tukholmassa oleskeleva serbialainen pokerinpelaaja Dragan.

programme.desc: Lahjakas asianajaja Casey McKay matkustaa ex-vaimonsa kotikaupunkiin puolustamaan tämän veljeä, jota syytetään piirisyyttäjän murhasta. Siellä McKay saa selville salaliiton, joka johtaa hänet avoimeen konfliktiin kaupungin korruptoituneimman rakennuttajan Gatesin kanssa.

programme.title: Horizon Line
programme.desc: Ex-pariskunta tapaa vuosien jälkeen osallistuessaan hyvän ystävänsä häihin. Heidän lentäessään trooppiselle saarelle valtameren yli pienellä, yksimoottorisella lentokoneella, pilotti saa kohtalokkaan sydänkohtauksen.

programme.title: Pete Smalls Is Dead
programme.desc: Hollywoodin taakseen jättänyt käsikirjoittaja joutuu palaamaan unelmien kaupunkiin ohjaajaystävänsä kuoltua.

programme.title: Reunalla
programme.desc: Uskallatko ottaa seuraavan askeleen? Vankikarkuri Nick Cassidy ilmestyy yhtäkkiä pilvenpiirtäjän reunukselle New Yorkissa. Aikooko hän hypätä?

programme.title: Killerman
programme.desc: Moe Diamond kasvoi New Yorkin timanttikeskuksen takahuoneissa opetellen jalokivialaa pohjalta alkaen. Nyt Moe käyttää yhteyksiään pestäkseen miljoonia dollareita laitonta rahaa.

programme.title: Bulletproof Monk
programme.desc: Vuosikausien ajan nimetön munkki on puolustanut ja suojellut muinaista kääröä – Äärettömän Voiman Kääröä – joka sisältää avaimen mittaamattomaan voimaan. Nyt munkin täytyy löytää suojatti; seuraava suojelija salaisuudelle.

programme.title: A Score to Settle
programme.desc: Frank on lusinut vankilassa 22 vuotta - syyttömänä. Vapauduttuaan hän aikoo etsiä käsiinsä kaikki ne ihmiset, jotka pettivät hänet ja joiden takia hän joutui linnaan.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Luc Bessonin toimintaelokuvan pääosassa upea Zoe Saldana (Avatar) pukeutuu koston mustaan raivatessaan tieltään vanhempiensa tappajat.COLOMBIANA on toiminnantäyteinen tarina nuoresta tytöstä, joka joutuu raakuuksien ja koston maailmaan.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Taxi 4
programme.desc: Pahanilmanlintu Émilienillä Marseillen rikospoliisista on huostassaan yksi Euroopan etsityimmistä miehistä.

Along the way, she finds out the secrets to the quintessential Bhutanese peace and contentment.

programme.title: Xplore Bhutan
programme.desc: Actress and travel enthusiast, Radhika Bangia explores the enigma that is Bhutan, when she visits Thimpu, the capital city with no traffic lights and no skyscrapers invading the skyline. Here, she checks out significant sights such as the Tibetan-style National Memorial Chorten, the National Library and the Folk Heritage Museum in order to understand more about the beliefs, history, architecture and cuisine of Bhutan.

programme.title: Xplore Bhutan
programme.desc: Known as Druk Yul or the “Land of the Thunder Dragon”, Bhutan is the country of mountains, monasteries and mystery. Radhika Bangia finds this to be true when she visits Punakha, the former capital of Bhutan, where she marvels at the architecture of Punakha Dzong and gets to know the story behind the two rivers, Mo Chhu and Po Chhu. She also explores the sacred temples and Mebar Tsho lake of Bumthang, the religious heart of Bhutan, and gets to know the local legends.

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland
programme.desc: Robbie’s journey to reconnect with his Scottish roots begins in Edinburgh, the stunning capital city perched on extinct volcanoes. Navigating the twists of the Royal Mile, strutting around the majestic Edinburgh castle and learning to sip scotch like a true Scotsman, he feels a tad closer to his heritage. The real fun kicks in, however, when he stumbles onto a rather flamboyant way to unleash his inner Highlander.

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria
programme.desc: Like Rome, Plovdiv straddles seven hills; but as Europe’s oldest continuously inhabited city, it’s far more ancient. As Catriona takes a tour of the city to see its iconic attractions such as a Roman Amphitheatre, which was once the setting for gladiator fights, and the striking Baroque Saints Constantine and Helena Church, she begins to see how seamlessly modern life blends with the age-old ruins. Along the way, she realizes why Plovdiv is called the ‘Eternal City’ of Bulgaria.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Host George Kourounis has braved many terrifying phenomena – but none as frightening as the one he takes on in this episode: marriage! To make sure his new bride is on the same adventurous page with him, he proposes to get married on the lip of an exploding volcano, on the South Pacific island of Tanna, in Vanuatu. Before the native preacher, dressed in grass skirt and kustom garb, gets to perform the smoky vows, George descends into the erupting volcano to bring out red hot samples of the lava it is producing.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Avalanche danger is very high in the Rogers Pass area of the Trans Canada Highway in British Columbia. Host of Angry Planet George Kourounis travels with a variety of experts to bring down huge avalanches in the Rocky Mountains. Ski Patrollers throw hand charges to clear the slopes, the British Columbia Department of Highways uses helicopter bombing and mountaintop mortars to keep the roads safe, and the Canadian Armed Forces fire 105mm howitzers at the mountains to bring down the dangerous snow. Still, there are accidents and fatalities in the mountains. We meet Francois Desroisers, an avalanche burial victim who tells a terrible and tragic tale of a mountain disaster.

programme.desc: Barrett has chained up Yuya and his monsters! Can Yuya break his shackles before Barrett breaks away with Celina?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya’s battle with Barrett comes to a shocking conclusion when a mind-controlled madman drops into their duel!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: It’s Jack’s most dangerous duel ever as he takes on Roget’s maniacal minion - Sergey!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Can Jack Atlas best Sergey, when Sergey combines the best of man and machine?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Roget declares himself leader of New Domino City! Can the Lancers overthrow this madman, or will Roget’s Sector Security end any chances they have?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The Friendship Cup finale is finally here! Jack and Yuya square off to see who will become New Domino City’s newest champion!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Jack pushes Yuya to his limits in the Friendship Cup finale! Does Yuya have the dueltaining skills to dethrone the Master of Faster, or will Jack’s rule reign supreme?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: With the City on the edge of their seats, a new champion is about to be crowned! But who will sit in the winner’s circle: Yuya or Jack?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The Friendship Cup may be over, but trouble sure isn’t! Roget is planning to take Zuzu to Duel Academy!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya reaches a new place - Heartland City, the hometown of Yuto and Shay in the Xyz Dimension along with Sylvio and Gong. There they meet Duel Academy soldiers and an independent warrior from that dimension.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Gongenzaka and Sawatari fight against the mysterious Kaito, who believes them to be agents of Academia. As he summons his fearsome Galaxy Eyes Cipher Dragon, Yuto notes that something has changed in Kaito.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Kaito begins a merciless assault against Yuya with his powerful Galaxy Eyes deck. With Yuto's spirit on his side, Yuya tries to match Kaito's indomitable spirit with both Odd Eyes Pendulum Dragon and Dark Rebellion Xyz Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya and the others meet the Xyz Resistance, who discuss how Heartland fell to ruin and Yusho's mysterious connection to them. Elsewhere, in the Fusion Dimension, Yuzu flees Academia soldiers when someone unexpected comes to her rescue.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yusho explains what happened during his disappearance to Yuzu while in the Fusion Dimension. Back in Heartland, Yuya comes across an angry youth with a grudge against his Dueltaining style as Yuto refuses to stand by any longer.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Shun is determined to convince Kaito to rejoin the Resistance despite Kaito's adamant refusal. As the former friends cannot convince each other either way, they decide all they can do is fight against each other.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yusho reveals that three years ago he learned of the Arc Area Project and Academia's machinations, going on a journey to stop Leo's plans. Yuri arrives at the You Show Duel School to stamp out the resistance against Academia.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Allen and Sayaka try to fight Kaito only to end up facing Grace and Gloria Tyler, two of Academia's strongest enforcers. Having no choice but to fight, they face off against the Tyler's Amazoness deck.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: As Sawatari and Gongenzaka both fail to defeat the Tyler sisters, Yuya and Shun arrive to meet their challenge. In the face of their near perfect combo, Yuya must not give into his rage and defeat his powerful foes.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya and the others try to return to the Resistance base when they are attacked by the Obelisk Force. They try to face the power of the Obelisk Force when Shun becomes gravely injured during the battles.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Academia's enforcer Edo Phoenix challenges Yuya to a rematch. Torn between his allegiance to the Professor and his spirit of Dueltaining, a confused Edo is determined to crush Yuya and the ghost of Yusho that haunts him.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: As their duel goes on, Edo only becomes more conflicted of where his allegiances lie. Seeing Edo suffer, Yuya is determined to remind him how fun dueling can be and begins his greatest Dueltaining performance yet.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Convincing Edo, the Tyler twins, and the rest of the forces in Heartland to join their side, Yuya and the other Lancers prepare to head to the Fusion Dimension to find their friends and restore everyone who has been turned into a card.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya encounters his old foe from the Junior Youth Championship, Kachidoki. Kachidoki continues to use violent tactics and powerful Fusions in his Action Duels as Yuya tries to return a smile to his heart.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya and co board a ship to Duel Academy when Dennis catches up to them, aiming to defeat Yusho once and for all. A still vengeful Kaito meets Dennis's challenge as the two unleash their greatest monsters.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Serena, who appeared before the Lancers, suddenly betrays them and captures Yuzu while Yuya is forced to fight Captain Solo. Caught between useless cards and Solo's lock deck, things seem hopeless when more allies suddenly arrive.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yugo meets with up the others and agree to work together against Academia. Yugo and Kaito head to the towers where Rin and Ruri are being held captive, only to face the guardians Apollo and Diana.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The Doctor has brainwashed Ruri and Rin, leading them to fight against Yugo and Kaito. Meanwhile, Reiji recounts how all of Yuya's counterparts as well as all the bracelet girls are part of Leo's ultimate plan: Revival Zero.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya and the Lancers finally make it the Academy, but they are captured and thrown into a wild battle royale against the Obelisk Force. However, a mysterious enemy in the royale begins wiping out friend and foe alike.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Allie is looking to make a big splash at the Arc League Championship, but she soon finds herself in over her head! Can Allie's deck of fishy friends turn the tides, or will her mysterious opponent sink her chances of winning?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The wild duelist known as Battle Beast crushes his fellow Academy students and even turns Crow and Tsukikage into cards. Yuya and Gongenzaka arrive to face the challenge of their insane foe.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Jack appears out of nowhere and joins Yuya in fighting against Battle Beast. Battle Beast's instructor, Sanders, joins in the duel as well to show the power and glory of the Academy to the Lancers.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Battle Beast continues his rampage against friend and foe alike. Sensing nothing but rage and anger in Battle Beast's heart, Yuya is determined to show him how fun dueling can actually be and aims to purge his demons.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Asuka stays behind to fight Yuri while Sora and the others go on ahead. Yuri uses a different deck and fights Asuka, who tries to reach out a helping hand to Yuri. That's when Yuri reveals the real reason why he does what he does.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya comes across Ruri, who is still under the control of the Doctor's parasites. Yuya attempts to fight off Ruri, made harder when Serena joins the fight. Yuto decides to take control and face the two girls.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya and Yuto are struggling in their battle against Ruri and Serena and their Parasite Queen. The Doctor attempts to take control of Yuya using a parasite as well, but that only awakens the rage inside of Yuya once again.

programme.title: A King and His Queen
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Suomen tulli

programme.title: Australian rajalla
programme.desc: Kausi 17. Jakso 14/20. Vihreä tee ja valkoinen jauhe. Turistiviisumilla matkustavan venäläismiehen liikehdintä Australian ja Balin välillä herättää virkailijoiden huomion Brisbanessa. Sydneyssä vain meloninsiemenistä ilmoittaneelta kiinalaisnaiselta löytyy matkatavaroista bioturvallisuusriskejä, jotka tulevat hänelle kalliiksi. Melbournessa vihreäksi teeksi ilmoitettu lentorahti sisältää miljoonien arvosta jotain aivan muuta. Australialainen realitysarja.

programme.title: Kuppilat kuntoon, Gordon Ramsay!

Nykyään lähes kaikki ruoka on suoraan pakastimesta. Tämähän ei Gordonille käy. Saako hän itsepäisen ravintoloitsijan antamaan lapsilleen mahdollisuuden tehdä ravintolasta laadukas? Amerikkalainen realitysarja.

programme.title: Kuppilat kuntoon, Gordon Ramsay!

programme.title: Tulossa: Temptation Island Suomi
programme.desc: Viettelysten kuumat tuulet puhaltavat jälleen, kun neljä eri elämäntilanteessa ja parisuhteen vaiheessa olevaa pariskuntaa matkaa Espanjan auringon alle selvittämään, onko nykyinen kumppani se oikea. Pariskunnat laittavat suhteensa todelliseen painetestiin, kun heidät erotetaan toisistaan ja kuvioon astuu liuta kuumia viettelijäsinkkuja. Matkan varrella Sami Kurosen isännöimät iltanuotiot tarjoilevat totutusti väläyksiä kumppanin elämästä toisella villalla. Kauden aikana painitaan pienten sekä isojen kysymysten kanssa. Millainen kumppani on itselle sopiva? Kuinka löytää suhteen kadonnut liekki? Kuinka paljon voi vaatia toista muuttumaan? Voiko pettämisen antaa anteeksi? Viimeisellä iltanuotiolla selviää, onko parisuhteilla edellytyksiä jatkua ohjelman jälkeen. Ja kun viimeinen iltanuotio sammuu, on sinkuille luvassa aivan erityinen yllätys. Kotimainen realityohjelma.

programme.title: Kulturplatz
programme.desc: Zum ersten Mal im deutschsprachigen Raum widmet sich ein Festival der geschriebenen Reportage. 60 Reporterinnen und Reporter aus aller Welt präsentieren in Bern ihre Geschichten.Eine globale Jury wählt aus 39 nominierten Texten den besten aus und verleiht den True Story Award. Kulturplatz begibt sich mitten hinein in dieses Festival, das der Vertrauenskrise des Journalismus die Qualität von Reportagen entgegensetzen will.Es sind vielleicht nicht die besten Tage für den Journalismus weltweit. In den USA spricht ein Präsident permanent von Fake News, im deutschsprachigen Raum politisiert die eine rechtsradikale Partei mit dem Begriff Lügenpresse. Sogar das renommierte Nachrichtenmagazin Der Spiegel wurde von einem handfesten Fälschungsskandal heimgesucht.Fast zum Trotz – könnte man meinen – findet in Bern das erste Reportagenfestival im deutschsprachigen Raum statt. Drei Tage lang wird an unterschiedlichsten Orten gelesen und diskutiert. Reporterinnen und Reporter erzählen von ihrer Arbeit, von schwierigen Arbeitsbedingungen, von komplizierten Recherchen und politischen Repressalien. Ist das ein Zufall? Oder müssen bestimmte Formen des Journalismus kritisch hinterfragt werden? Wenn eine Geschichte durch bestimmte Formen des Erzählens nicht mehr der Wirklichkeit entspricht, weil das Geschichtenerzählen, das Storytelling die Wahrhaftigkeit verbiegt? Wenn das verkaufbare Produkt im Vordergrund steht, und nicht die Wahrheit?

Hier teilen sich mehr Länder einen derartig kleinen Raum wie nirgendwo sonst auf der Welt. Durch ständige Rivalität entsteht ein Wettbewerb, der die Europäer antreibt, die Welt zu erobern.

Diese Konstellation ermöglichte es ihrem Zentrum, den USA, an die Weltspitze aufzusteigen und die Kulturen aller anderen Kontinente zu prägen.
